newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Chem seen posting operating loss - paper.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Chem seen posting operating loss - paper.

text.p: Mitsubishi Chemical Corp is expected to post a parent operating loss of about two billion yen in the year to March 31, due to sluggish chemical product prices and a rise in materials prices, a Japanese business daily said on Friday.
It would be the company's first operating loss in three years, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
A company official was not immediately available to comment on the report, but the firm has said it would post a parent operating profit of six billion yen.
It posted an actual parent operating profit of 35.02 billion yen in 1995/96.
The paper said the company would sell securities to avoid posting a parent current loss in 1996/97.
